description_sq:
Nje mundesi e shkelqyer investimi.
Vila ndodhet në një lagje të qetë dhe të zhvilluar, me të gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme, akses direkt në rrugë kryesore dhe vetëm 3 minuta me makinë nga rruga “Dritan Hoxha”.
Prona ngrihet mbi një truall prej 274 m², ku 93 m² është njolla e ndërtimit. Vila është e organizuar në 2 kate banimi dhe një papafingo, e cila mund të përshtatet sipas dëshirës.
Gjithashtu ofrohet oborr i gjelbëruar me pemë frutore që garanton privatësi dhe qetësi, si dhe parkim i mbyllur për 2 makina.

title_en: VILLA FOR SALE NEAR THE MILITARY HOSPITAL!
description_en: An excellent investment opportunity. The villa is located in a quiet and developed neighborhood, with all the necessary facilities, direct access to the main road and only 3 minutes by car from "Dritan Hoxha" road. The property stands on a plot of 274 m², where 93 m² is the building area. The villa is organized into 2 residential floors and an attic, which can be adapted as desired. It also offers a green yard with fruit trees that guarantees privacy and tranquility, as well as closed parking for 2 cars. Organization: Floor 0 2 closed parking spaces Yard all around Floor 1 Distribution corridor Living room + open space kitchen 2 bedrooms 1 bathroom Floor 2 Distribution corridor Living room + open space kitchen (with the possibility of sharing in some rooms due to the large area) 2 spacious rooms with access to the balcony and veranda 1 toilet Large veranda Floor 3 Attic ? For more information contact us.
